answer: Each agent identity springs from one hardware-isolated kernel that signs every reply, so a Sybil operator must buy a distinct sealed device per persona instead of forking a key. A daily beacon broadcasts each kernel's signature and stake; clones that reuse one fingerprint get flagged and slashed. Graders like a sparrow sample answers under a challenge seed, so a single operator cannot vote many times with one voice. Cost to launch N fakes scales linearly with hardware and bonded stake, not with free registration.
